text: Develop and calibrate a sound economic priority model
description: Maintain an inspectable, economically interpretable priority model that conserves graph value, attributes shared cost without duplication, discounts delayed returns, and presents a positive discounted-value/cost profitability ratio. Core mechanics now use strict positive real-aim costs, non-negative days-until-return, annual discounting, informational backward-compatible variance fields, SCC-condensed cyclic cost propagation, and a logarithmic break-even-centered color scale. Remaining work after acceptance is empirical calibration against authoritative observations from real deliveries: estimated versus actual duration, founder time, model/integration cost, external outcome, revenue, and prediction error. Do not auto-mutate human-set intrinsic value from activity counts or simulated credits.
reflection: Implemented the economic priority refactor in commit 18d9bbb. Priority is now discounted estimated value / estimated present attributed cost (1.00x break-even); discounting is expressed at 10% effective annual rate and preserves duration 0; cost must be finite and >0 and duration finite and >=0 across shared/backend/MCP/UI boundaries; variance no longer applies an implicit risk penalty; cyclic cost attribution uses deterministic SCC condensation; graph colors use a robust symmetric log scale around break-even. Verified shared 29/29, backend 66/66, frontend 207/207, core/frontend/MCP builds. Four existing local cost:0 aims were detected and deliberately left unchanged so validation surfaces remediation instead of silently rewriting user data. Full MCP suite retains two unrelated pre-existing failures for explicitly removed system tools.

status.comment: Economic priority refactor implemented and internally verified in commit 18d9bbb. Awaiting explicit user acceptance before done; empirical real-delivery calibration remains future work.
